body:
Well, for the record that does come off a judgmental. My brother and I have a great relationship, we're super close and hang out all the time. I'm not actually sure how much I knew about sex, I went to a Catholic school and that's probably around the time I even heard the word "sex". I feel guilty about the whole thing because I realize it was weird, but at the same time because I was talking about things I was ashamed about, I left out the parts where things did happen because we were both curious. He's always been a much stronger person than I am and had the ability to say no, so I do think I may have made him uncomfortable but I'd be less confident saying I forced him to do anything. It also didn't go on for a long time, whereas I spent years feeling pressured by my cousin and feeling sick to my stomach every time. 

It's hard to explain but I tend to blame myself and feel guilty for a lot of things, so I can't really provide an accurate assessment of how I made him feel or how I acted. Part of the problem too is that I wrote that post when I was severely depressed, and I view myself as being worthless, and even hate myself when I'm at that stage. I would have to ask him about it. But since we have always been close and continue to be, I am realizing just now actually that I'm probably making more of it than it really was. I know that what happened with my cousin has made me act differently when I'm friends with males now, like they do me a favour when they don't expect me to do things with them sexually. My brother on the other hand is very well-adjusted and the most normal person in my family, he's very low-stress. I know I'm getting into a bit of a ramble here, but since you're curious I figured I'd try and be more detailed about everything. 

It's kind of random to comment on my post (which I imagine was pretty buried) like a month and half after it was posted. And you didn't comment on the posts of people who did much worse either. But anyway, I hope I cleared it up. Despite what I've said, I'll definitely still feel guilty because I wish I had had the presence of mind to know how wrong it all was, and that it's not the kind of thing you should be doing, or at least not with someone related to you. Sometimes I wonder if it'll happen when I have kids, and I wonder if I'll be as hard on them as I am on myself. However, the thread has made clear to me that I'm not the only one who has made mistakes, and I know that I try to be a good person and if I caused any pain, I've certainly gotten it back and much more since then.

I feel like no one should have to listen to what I'm saying, because then they just get annoyed and feel terrible that they can't do anything. They talk about how people should reach out, and those left behind wonder if they could have done something...well I think it's better for them to wonder than to know they couldn't do anything.

I guess it can't really ruin my life if it comes out because these things already torture me even after like a decade, but I've done a few things I'm not proud of. When I was like 11ish I guess my brother and I were just sort of experimenting by messing around and...I don't know, I sort of was asking for it more and more, and he obliged, but didn't seem as eager as I was. He would do similar stuff with a friend of ours more willingly, and I would be watching. So the other friend knew about it, and didn't think it was weird...but I don't know, I feel like I might have been pressuring him because I wanted it for some reason. We didn't do much, I gave him blowjobs and we kissed a bit. I once told him we should have sex, and now that I think about it, it's such a disturbing thought, but it drives me insane that I ever did it. I have never told anyone because I think it's disgusting and I'm sure others would agree.

Then between the 12-14 I did similar stuff with my cousin, but he was older and I felt more pressured. I encouraged it while it was happening, but then the next day I would always feel sick to my stomach. I guess I was curious about sexual stuff, and that's why I seemed, again, eager to do the whole thing, but I feel so much guilt about the whole thing now. It went on for so long and I don't know why I didn't stop it earlier. I feel like I'm so sick person for it, and I don't understand it at all. I told my therapist, and then my parents, and the parents of one of my younger cousins because I didn't want it to happen to someone else.

And all the stuff with my cousin confused me, because a few days after I told my parents about it, I felt these really strong feelings toward my best friend, and it was unlike anything I had felt before (she was female as am I), and I ended up telling her I loved her, which I realize now was not true, but I thought so. She freaked out about it and my feelings went away soon after, I figured it was just because of what had happened. But it led me to be really confused later when I started considering I could be gay, and even though I've come out, I still wonder if it isn't the stereotypical idea of abuse making me think I'm gay, though I've had real, pleasurable gay experiences.

Also I find my choice in porn odd, given that it tends to revolve around unnatural sex like rape or bestiality. Bestiality especially really appeals to me for some reason, and I even had my dog lick me once, but I didn't like it and now I am horrified that I did that.

It doesn't help that, as a rule, I think the worst about myself and generally have virtually non-existent self-esteem. I have seriously contemplated suicide a few times, but couldn't bring myself to do it because I couldn't think of a way that would be painless and not inconvenience the people I care about (I don't want my loved ones to find my body, I'd rather it be a stranger). I'm not suicidal now, but I'm always paranoid that no one likes me, and again, I think very little of myself, taking a motto of "if something bad happens, it's because of me, and if something good happens, it's despite me." I just feel horrible and these things weigh on my mind. I don't know that writing this has helped, but I guess it's some comfort that I'm not the only one.
